name: @pipeworx/mcp-packagephobia

tools.name: size
tools.description: Return the publish size and full install size (including dependencies) in bytes for an npm package name and optional version via packagephobia.com.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-packagephobia forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the packagephobia pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
